title: David defeats the Philistines at the balsam trees
description: The Philistines attack again and spread out in the valley. David asks God, who tells him to go around the enemy and attack when he hears the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees. David follows the order, defeats the Philistine army from Gibeon all the way to Gezer, and his name becomes known in all lands. [ref:1 Chr 14:13-17|1 Chronicles 14:13-17]
